sc: 18-month-old drinking 1 litre of cow's milk a day, pallor, pica, low MCV, low ferritin → Iron deficiency: oral iron
Pallor, purpura, bone pain, big liver and spleen → Acute leukaemia: bone marrow
Infant of a vegan mother, macrocytic anaemia, regression → Vitamin B12 deficiency
f: Microcytic: iron deficiency, thalassaemia, chronic disease, lead · normocytic: haemolysis, bleeding, marrow failure · macrocytic: B12, folate
Pallor (palms, conjunctiva), koilonychia · jaundice + spleen = haemolysis · purpura, fever = marrow failure or leukaemia
CBC, MCV, blood film, reticulocytes first · ferritin (iron stores) · haemolysis screen · bone marrow if pancytopenia
Low ferritin, high TIBC · cause: diet (milk), worms, blood loss · elemental iron 3–6 mg/kg/day, continue 3 months after Hb normal
Consider if Hb < 7 g/dL with symptoms · always if < 4 g/dL or heart failure · slow, packed cells
Aplastic (drugs, hepatitis; stem cell transplant) · Fanconi (absent thumbs, short) · Diamond–Blackfan (red cell aplasia) · TEC (recovers)
trap: A transfusion does not refill iron stores: still give 3 months of iron · pancytopenia → bone marrow (aplastic vs leukaemia vs kala-azar) · Hb lowest at 8–12 weeks is physiological
